verdict.rationale: Raygun's docs say it groups errors by exception type, class name, method name and location within the stack trace. That is stack-trace fingerprinting that collapses duplicates into error groups with occurrence counts. The pack shows no way to customize or override grouping when it is wrong: ignore rules and error statuses manage triage, not grouping. Missing for 10: custom grouping rules/fingerprint overrides, merge/split of error groups, independent or hands-on corroboration of grouping quality.
